dialogs.content: A courier told me that our combat readiness liaison found an excellent certification officer.
Turns out that it's you. An encouraging sign.
Tsk, so they've even gone to YOU, of all people? Hey, Kinich, looks like freaks of a feather do flock together — this commission-freak never learned to say no either!
Oh, look. A new commission notification — "to shut a noisy dragon up."
Oh, that? I just posted it.
You... You... So that's how it's gonna be, huh? Ganging up on the Almighty Dragonlord... Just you wait!
#Anyway, back on topic, {NICKNAME}. We'd like your help certifying these stages. Their difficulty and balance should be up to par.
Difficulty? Where? Pfft! Don't be ridiculous.
And what would you consider difficult? "Have them randomly pick some halfwit partner before rappelling down a mountain blindfolded"?
And perhaps you'd also make it so that they'd only have a ten-percent chance of getting a Yumkasaur buddy, with their other options being Avatars of Lava or Geo Slimes?
That's practically begging for death.
Hah, haven't you been tagging along with my little lackey long enough to know that that's just what the Scions of the Canopy love doing? My suggestion's perfect for them.
Perhaps you'd like to give us a demonstration, then?
...Such trivial challenges are far beneath the Almighty Dragonlord's dignity. Just amuse yourselves however you please, peons!
In any case, Irade offered me a good rate. Here's to you finding enjoyment in the challenge — and receiving satisfactory payment.
I'm looking forward to it!
I wish you well.
Leave it to me, Kinich!
Oooh, now we're really talking...
Hark! Hark! Now here's a person of refined tastes — way better than yours, at least!
But I'd love to watch Ajaw show us how a pro does it first.

I second that motion, Ajaw. You are much more agile than the average challenger. And even if a monster gets lucky and lands a hit, not like you'll get smacked straight into an Ajaw-shaped hole in the ground, right?
Oh, don't worry, you can handle that one later.
Hmph! Do you think such paltry flattery means that the Almighty Dragonlord will owe you one or something?
